title: Chiang Rai Provincial Hospital system, Thailand (Country A, XXR)
description: The hospital record system and DVC issuing service of Chiang Rai Provincial Hospital in Thailand (Country A, the birth country): issues one DVC per birth dose (J1), signing with the DSC of GDHCN DEV test participant XXR (kid kW/6VnwPRKI=, hex 916ffa567c0f44a2), which plays Thailand in the demonstrator. XXR is a DEV test participant, not Thailand's production key.

parts.title: Patient record (EHR)
parts.description: The hospital's electronic health record, in which the vaccinator records each birth dose given to the newborn (J1).

parts.title: Immunization record service
parts.description: Keeps the newborn's immunizations as FHIR Immunization resources, from which each DVC is made (J1).

parts.title: Vaccine product code registry
parts.description: Publishes the vaccine product codes the hospital records doses against, which the receiving country maps to its own schedule codes (J1, J3).

parts.title: DVC signer (HCERT)
parts.description: Builds each Digital Vaccination Certificate as an HCERT payload and has it signed with Thailand's document signer key, published to GDHCN (J1).
